Peaceful refers to free from conflict or disturbance, and she appeared peaceful; however, peaceful describes an absence of conflict, while serene refers to a state of utter calm and repose.
Tranquil refers to calm and peaceful, and she was tranquil; however, tranquil describes a general state of calm, while serene refers specifically to utter calm and unruffled repose.
Unflustered refers to not confused or disconcerted, and she remained unflustered; however, unflustered emphasizes not being confused, while serene refers to utter calm.
Poised refers to balanced and prepared, and she appeared poised under questioning; however, poised emphasizes readiness and balance, while serene refers to utter calm.
